status: Completed reanalysis of published data; no model inference or training performed.

workload_mix.caveat: Illustrative two-condition weighting of cross-source aggregates; not a deployment threshold or causal experiment.

real_trials.interval_caveat: Assumes independent Bernoulli trials; these 30 trials repeat 15 scenes/objects. This is descriptive, not a population guarantee.

latency_caveat: Arithmetic sensitivity only. BF16 mean reasoning length / NVFP4 decode rate; excludes prefill, vision, movement, networking, and quantization-induced longer reasoning.
